did: Built the Cooking page on the home web app: each of your goals is a train on its way to what you want, its stops the things that must happen first, each saying whether it waits on you, Claude, the checks or home. A thin bar at the top names the most urgent blocker; one card shows a stop with every train in miniature; the trains below open to their purpose, behind a Show and Order menu. It reads the coordinator's record on the day's run issue and what GitHub says, and nothing is kept on home. The phone gets a link to it in Settings. You picked the layout from three rounds of prototypes.

calls.title: Where the page's record lives, and what was built
options: GitHub as the store, one record block on the run issue, only the page built
calls.why: GitHub already holds everything but the sessions, and a board would be a second copy kept current by a bot (C1115).
calls.undo: Record a call that moves C1115, and point the page at a board instead.

calls.title: How urgent a stop is, and its colour
options: who holds it sets the colour, and now, today or whenever its weight, worked out from the trains
colour by who holds it only
calls.why: You asked for colours by who blocks and how urgent; deriving urgency keeps the record from carrying an opinion it must keep current (C1119).
calls.undo: Record a call that moves C1119.

left: You see the page on home only after the web app's next image and a home deploy.
Nobody has looked at the built page in a browser: it sits behind your passkey, and the session couldn't sign in. The prototypes showed the same layout.
Nothing checks a run block before it lands; a bad one leaves the page showing only a link to the run issue.
